name: modern-front-design
description: 现代企业级 B2B Fintech CRM 仪表盘设计技能（设计/审计/进度三模式）。Light Skeuomorphism / Soft UI 风格族：浅色基调、玻璃拟态微光、克制饱和色、慷慨留白。内置 design_audit.py 审计脚本，可生成现代化迁移报告、迁移方案并追踪迁移进度。
author: alex

dependencies.name: python3
dependencies.description: Python 3 stdlib only (argparse, colorsys, json, os, re, sys)

scripts.name: design_audit.py
scripts.description: Scan a frontend project against the modern-front-design spec; emit audit reports, snapshots, and progress comparisons
